Council Member Emmanuel J Estrada on Instagram: "Baldwin Park is taking proactive steps to protect our community.

On March 4, 2026, the City Council adopted a 45-day moratorium on new data centers. On April 15, 2026, we voted to extend that moratorium for an additional 10 months and 15 days.

Our residents’ concerns are valid.
Baldwin Park already faces significant environmental burdens from nearby freeways and quarries. We also sit above the San Gabriel Valley groundwater basin, protecting our water and natural resources is critical to our health and sustainability.

Data centers are expanding rapidly due to artificial intelligence and cloud computing and they can come with real impacts such as high energy demand, large water usage, and added strain on infrastructure.

Our city currently does not have specific regulations in place to address those impacts.

Baldwin Park has not received any proposals for data centers. We are taking a proactive approach and planning ahead.

During this moratorium, city staff will be studying potential impacts, evaluating best practices, and developing clear regulations and standards to guide any future proposals. That includes looking at infrastructure capacity, environmental considerations, and compatibility with our community.

We will continue to keep our community informed and provide updates as they become available throughout this process."
